verdict.rationale: Flagright documents region-specific API servers (a default eu-1 sandbox server and an asia-1 sandbox server), so a deployment is tied to a named region a compliance officer can identify. Nothing documents what region is contractually committed for data processing or how data moving across borders is handled. Missing for 10: contracted data-residency/processing-region commitments, cross-border transfer handling documentation, production region documentation, a way to verify region per tenant, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can verify the contracted processing region and cross-border handling for the chosen deployment
